name: neowatch
description: 📺 Self-hostable worldwide free live-TV, radio & public-domain-film aggregator — React PWA + Node. HLS player, multi-screen, EPG, TV/D-pad UX. Aggregates public streams (iptv-org / radio-browser / Internet Archive); hosts no content.

paragraphs: Self-hostable live TV, radio and public-domain films, in one fast app.

About 12,000 of the world's freely published live channels, internet radio and public-domain movies, with a fast player, a 9-screen mosaic, a TV guide and a remote-friendly TV layout. Every channel is free.

NEOWATCH is an aggregator and player for publicly available media. It hosts no content: it indexes and plays streams that broadcasters already publish openly. Live TV comes from the iptv-org directory, internet radio from radio-browser, and public-domain films from the Internet Archive. It ships as a React PWA backed by a thin Node/Express API, deployable as one process on a small VPS.
features: About 12,000 live channels worldwide, every iptv-org category, with logos, country, language and quality. All free to watch.
Internet radio from the radio-browser directory, with a sticky audio player.
Public-domain films from the Internet Archive, played natively.
TV guide: now/next on cards and channel pages, a day grid at /programme-tv, and programme search (XMLTV sources).
Tuned hls.js: fast start, adaptive bitrate, low latency; YouTube embeds.

whatItDoes.text: Self-hostable live TV, radio and public-domain films, in one fast app.

requirements.text: QR sign-in: scan a code on the TV, approve on the phone.
On first boot the server caches the iptv-org catalog (a few seconds) and creates an admin account.
